parts.headline: AI Spending Has Met Its First Real Bill
The Model Is Not the Price

mentions.excerpt: First Pacific Advisors LP works the numbers from the bottom.

First Pacific Advisors LP, on July 30, projected global AI spending of $2.59 trillion in 2026 and counted $207 billion a year of after-tax income for even a low return, which its managers call improbable.
